funding_rule: Every offered contract escrows its promised institutional payment from the exact issuer before acceptance. No unfunded reward is created.
generation_rule: Escort demand may protect cargo, persistent people, traveling parties, or mixed convoys. Aggregate regional shortages are demand signals, not single shipments: ordinary public cargo offers commission one physically planned lot at a time. The publication target is not a world maximum; larger deliberate movements require correspondingly larger real transport, crew, provisions and security.
assignment_rule: Acceptance claims the contract for a beneficiary institution and records its principal participants. Departure forms the exact lawful field party, including an active standing retinue when already delegated to the leader. Civilian drivers, handlers, attendants and protected clients are not counted as martial escorts. No faction member is conjured or silently conscripted.
compensation_rule: Institutional contract revenue is paid to the beneficiary treasury. Faction members receive their normal monthly institutional compensation unless an explicit faction bonus policy exists; independent escorts may be contracted for direct payment.
